description_en: Defence and preparedness (försvar, beredskap and their compounds).
Crime, gang crime and law and order.
Säkerhet and every compound: security policy, but also traffic safety, legal certainty and social security.
Trygghet and its compounds, such as trygghetssystem: mostly welfare and social security.
Cultural heritage and cultural environments (kulturarv, kulturmiljö).
Every other word beginning with kultur: such as kulturpolitik, kulturell and kulturskola.
